code.description: e.g. "M", "FT", "KG" — globally unique across all categories

system.description: Omit for a universal/scientific unit (e.g. Kelvin) valid under any display system.

toBaseOffset.description: For affine conversions (e.g. Celsius/Fahrenheit). Defaults to 0.

isCanonical.description: Exactly one canonical unit is allowed per category — the category's base unit.

isSystemDefault.description: Exactly one default is allowed per (category, system) pair — the unit resolveDisplayUnit picks for that system. Requires `system` to be set.
